fields.label: Enabled
fields.help: The check every 15 minutes. Off: saving removes its timer; a scrub already running carries on (stop it with `scrub cancel`). On: saving puts the timer back.

fields.label: When a file is damaged
fields.help: stage: alert, find and verify a good copy, then wait for you to restore it. auto: swap in any copy that passes the check, then report. alert: only alert; finding a copy and restoring both wait for you.

groups.title: Where copies come from
groups.help: Tried in order, newest copy first; a copy must match every readable block.

fields.label: UniFi Cloud backups
fields.help: Look in your UniFi Cloud backup versions through UniFi Drive. Drive does the signing in; no credential is read.

fields.label: Folder sources
fields.help: Folders on the NAS that hold copies, comma-separated: a USB backup drive, a share a replication task copies into, a mount from another machine. Each is tried as <folder>/<share>/<path> and <folder>/<path>.

groups.title: Scrubs
groups.help: A read-only scrub reads every block to find damage; it changes nothing.

fields.label: Scrub after errors
fields.help: New checksum errors in the kernel log, or a parity mismatch from UniFi's data scrubbing, start an urgent scrub at once. It stops for manual jobs and UniFi's own, then carries on.

fields.label: Scheduled scrub
fields.help: Scrub on a calendar too, inside the night window, stopping at the end of each night and carrying on the next until it's done.

fields.label: How often
fields.help: Periods start in January. Quarterly: January, April, July and October.

fields.label: Start day
fields.help: The first night of each period. It runs every night from then until it's done.

fields.label: Night window
fields.help: Local time. A scheduled scrub runs only inside it. Urgent and manual scrubs don't wait for it.

groups.title: Heartbeat
groups.help: Empty: the shared heartbeat URLs in Notifications are used.

fields.label: Own heartbeat URL
fields.help: Pinged after every check that ends without errors, so this tool has its own check (a 15-minute period) apart from the others.

fields.label: Own heartbeat URL on failure
fields.help: Pinged instead when a check ends with errors (an open damaged file is one). Used only with the own heartbeat URL.
